reasons: The security.txt gate fails by design: the synthetic domain is a placeholder and no real security contact exists.
Six gates need a consuming project with an exact locked toolchain, a browser, a served preview or a deployment target, and have not run.
No owner, domain, hosting target, legal review of the privacy page, or rollback rehearsal exists for a fictional business.

gates.proves: no render-blocking head script, every image sized, no document.write, no unmarked-hero warning
all five routes inside the engine's global weight budgets; font weight reads 0 KB because no font files are bundled, so it is not representative of a shipped site
title, description, canonical, share tags, html lang and a zoom-safe viewport on every page
none of the 26 catalogued filler phrases appear in the rendered pages
five pages, no broken internal link, no orphan, every page reachable from the home page
no external script or stylesheet without integrity metadata (there are none)
no banned primary font, gradient, filler headline or other blocking pattern in the vendored detector's registry
no credential-shaped string in the tracked files of a scratch repository holding the site
the gate rejects a placeholder domain, which is correct for a synthetic site; every other check passes

not_assessed.reason: Needs a consuming project with exact locked Playwright and axe-core versions and an installed browser. The static html lang and viewport checks in metadata-audit are partial twins only.
Needs a locked Lighthouse CI toolchain and a browser. Field Core Web Vitals are a separate question and are not measured here.
Needs locked Playwright, a browser and committed visual baselines.
Needs a served preview or staging URL and a locked static server; local preview does not prove edge configuration.
Needs the consuming project's package-lock.json. The site itself has no dependencies; the audit step now stops with exit 6 when it cannot run.
The rubric score is a reviewer judgement and no scored report exists.
No deployment target exists for a fictional business.
No host. Local input validation of the rollback helper passes (see the README); remote state is not assessed.
